purpose: Teach: 澆/椶/僂/彡/シーク/同省/未確認/西方

lines.speaker: saito_doctor
lines.jp: 蓮さん、点滴の澆、つまり澆注速度を医療チームで管理します
lines.en: Ren, we manage the IV drip rate — the infusion speed — as a medical team.
lines.style: Clear, measured medical delivery. Slight pause before the clarification. Steady eye contact. Explaining without condescending. Clinical but humane.

lines.speaker: saito_doctor
lines.jp: 蓮さん、植物療法の椶、つまり椶櫚由来生薬を医療チームで研究します
lines.en: Ren, we're researching herbal therapy — plant-based medicines specifically — as a coordinated medical team.
lines.style: Same measured tone. Brief explanatory pause. Slightly warmer on the clarification. Still clinical. Inviting understanding rather than compliance.

lines.speaker: saito_doctor
lines.jp: 蓮さん、長時間労働の僂佝、つまり僂佝姿勢の労働者のケアを医療チームでおこないます
lines.en: Ren, we provide care for workers with prolonged labor-related postural strain — that's what we call it clinically — as a medical team.
lines.style: Steady, precise. Small pause for the technical term. No rush. Treating the explanation as important information, not filler. Quiet confidence.

lines.speaker: saito_doctor
lines.jp: 蓮さん、書類の彡、つまり彡偏の字を医療チームで正確に書きます
lines.en: Ren, we ensure our medical team writes characters with the radical stroke — the san radical — accurately on all documentation.
lines.style: Matter-of-fact detail. A hint of dry attention to procedure. Still warm underneath. This is care in precision.

lines.speaker: saito_doctor
lines.jp: 蓮さん、シーク教徒、つまりシーク派患者様の宗教的配慮を医療チームでおこないます
lines.en: Ren, we observe religious considerations for our Sikh patients — that's an important part of our care — as a medical team.
lines.style: Slightly more deliberate. The emphasis sits on respect. Not formal, but dignified. This matters and she is saying so clearly.

lines.speaker: saito_doctor
lines.jp: 蓮さん、同省、つまり厚労同省と医療チームで連携します
lines.en: Ren, we coordinate with the Ministry of Health — the same ministry — in all our medical protocols.
lines.style: Crisp, official without coldness. The clarification is quick and practiced. Still maintaining that underlying steadiness. This is routine important work.

lines.speaker: saito_doctor
lines.jp: 蓮さん、未確認の感染源を医療チームで追跡します
lines.en: Ren, we track unconfirmed sources of infection as part of our medical team's responsibility.
lines.style: Alert but not alarmed. Precise language. Slight weight on the word 'unconfirmed' — this is serious but manageable. She has done this before.

lines.speaker: saito_doctor
lines.jp: 蓮さん、西方医学、つまり西方医療の伝統と医療チームで対話します
lines.en: Ren, we dialogue with the traditions of Western medicine — understanding them, questioning them — as we move forward as a medical team.
lines.style: Thoughtful, slightly slower. The weight shifts to the philosophical aspect. Still clinical, but this one asks something of him — engagement, not just compliance. Close, final.
